description: Fetch a single campaign and its full untruncated asset copy, in-chat previewMarkdown, statusOverview, destination page names, character budgets, scheduledPosts/errorMessages, live URLs, and optional visual Social Feed Preview Card PNGs (includeVisualPreview: true).

includeVisualPreview.description: Set true when the user asks for a visual preview of the post in chat: renders a crisp Social Feed Preview Card PNG and returns it inline

platform.description: Optional platform filter (e.g. linkedin, instagram, x, threads, blog)
